# Git's textconv hands `sesam show` an absolute temp path outside the repo. A
# secret the user cannot read then shows a placeholder, so `git log -p` does
# not abort for non-recipients.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec sesam tell --user bob --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init sesam'

# Admin-only README.md: bob gets the placeholder instead of a fatal diff.
env SESAM_ID=$BOB_KEY
exec git log -p
stdout 'not a recipient of this secret'

# Asking for it directly still fails.
! exec sesam show README.md
